notes.title: Bugs fixed and new items added
notes.content:
update v.1.1.3.77

Bugs resolved


 Fixed the bug where the bomb was not absorbed by the player


New items

4 weapons have been added:

 gun
 rifle
 shotgun
 magno
 combat shotgun


New weapons will be added in the future.

Weapons can be found in chests hidden around the map and to open them you need a common key.

Added “coin” item that drops from dead enemies

Thank you all!! :)

notes.title: Update v.1.1.1.68
notes.content:
Small improvements were made:


 Now the player can jump from one shortcut to another without needing to be close to it as long as the shortcut is open.
 Blackheart hitbox has been fixed.
 The bug where the player did not receive damage from the black heart enemy was also fixed.


Thank you all!!

notes.title: Achievements
Update v.1.1.7.52
notes.content:
Bugs

 Fixed a bug where the lost items inventory was not updated in some runs.


New Item Added

 The new item "Machine Gun" that can be equipped in the heart has been added. The heart fires at closer targets dealing decent damage that can help with the run.


Many thanks to all players. Have a good time. :)

notes.title: Update v.1.1.6.50
notes.content:
Improvements made in this update:


 npcs prisoner interaction button
 inventory of items that were lost at death;
 code that prevents the player from dying after defeating a boss, even with hp at 0 points


Many thanks to all players. Have a good time. :)

notes.title: Achievements
notes.content:
///ACHIEVEMENTS///


 collect 30 capsules (accumulator) 
 collect 30 heart fragments (by collecting fragments) 
 collect 30 sphere fragments (by putting the pieces together) 
 complete a heart (full heart) 
 complete a sphere (a little more) 
 solve 30 puzzles (it's fun) 
 collect all upgrade items (stronger) 
 save the coffee addict (afternoon coffee) 
 save all prisoners (just helping) 
 change the color palette 50 times (routine change) 
 get 100% in the first 3 steps (good job) 
 kill 300 enemies (without pride) 
 Kill the first boss (Rain of bullets) 
 kill all bosses (winner) 
 buy 20 items with the discount coupon (go shopping) 
 kill any enemy with scenery objects(saving up) 
 kill any enemy using spikes (spike pig) 
 explode 30 bombs (by blowing things up) 
 mine 20 keys (the miner) 
 finish the game (brave bubble heart)


Thank you all! ^-^
